variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, grumbles that the Urchins of the barrow took her ring of mill keys; orders the player to get them, pays with a spell book, sends him to Anselm.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Oh, curse them all! Those Urchins have been into my mill again?!

They crawled up out of that old barrow east of the ford, and this time they took my ring of keys. The grain loft, the sluice, the front door -- all locked tight and me stood on the wrong side of them!

Go into the barrow and get my keys back. I'll teach you a spell for your trouble, and a good one.

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Hmph! And I took you for the helpful sort.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
My keys! Every last one of them! Oh, thank you, lad! Here's the spell book I promised you. Study it hard.

And go and see Brother Anselm at the Chapel of the Ford. His boy Pip never came back out of that barrow.

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: The wheel's turning again, thanks to you!

journal.text: Recover Wenna's mill keys from the Urchins' barrow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Wenna's mill keys from the Urchins' barrow.

variants.specifics: Bormunt: Quessel the fussy old assayer; the Imps took his Divining Rod down the old cart tunnel; he hands over the tunnel key at once and teaches a spell.

offer.speaker: Quessel
offer.text:
Oh, not again! Imps! Imps in my workshop?! They made off with my Divining Rod while I was having my nap, the wretched little thieves!

Without it I can't find a single vein of silver. If you could get it back, I'd teach you a spell my old master taught me. They went down the old cart tunnel west of here. Here, take this iron key, it opens the tunnel gate. Will you go?

refusal.speaker: Quessel
refusal.text: No? Hmph. Well, keep the key anyway. Perhaps you'll think better of it.

reminder.speaker: Quessel
reminder.text: Have you got my Rod? No?! Then what are you doing here?

completion.speaker: Quessel
completion.text:
My Divining Rod! Oh, bless you, bless you! I was sure those Imps had chewed it to bits.

Now, as promised. Sit down and read this, and mind you read it carefully. It's a good spell, a very good one.

after.speaker: Quessel
after.text: Thanks again, lad! I'm back to work at last!

journal.text: Recover Quessel's Divining Rod from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Quessel's Divining Rod from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Oskry: Quillon, a fussy alchemist, had his magic lantern stolen by Imps; they nest in the dead trees past the west walk.

offer.speaker: Quillon
offer.text: Gone! Gone! Those rotten little Imps came in my window last night and took my magic lantern right off its hook! And they tracked mud all over my floor! I can't do a bit of work without that lantern. Would you get it back for me?

refusal.speaker: Quillon
refusal.text: Fine! I'll just sit here in the dark, then.

reminder.speaker: Quillon
reminder.text: Where's my lantern?! Those Imps live up in the dead trees, out past the west walk. Everybody knows that!

completion.speaker: Quillon
completion.text: My lantern! My lantern! Thank you, thank you! Here, take this Ankh. A peddler sold it to me for good luck. It never brought me any, so maybe it will do better for you.

after.speaker: Quillon
after.text: Thanks again, kind stranger! I keep my window shut now.

journal.text: Get Quillon's magic lantern back from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Get Quillon's magic lantern back from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Castle Brask: Haskel the lookout lost his spyglass to the Urchins of Split Rock.

offer.speaker: Haskel
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer. Those blasted Urchins crept up the watchtower stair last night and stole my spyglass! I can't watch the north wall without it! They hide in the caves under Split Rock, east of the castle. Do me a favor and get it back, and I'll do you one. There's a pair of boots in the watch house that nobody's come for. Will you go?

refusal.speaker: Haskel
refusal.text: Then I'll find someone who will. Good day.

reminder.speaker: Haskel
reminder.text: No spyglass yet? I've been squinting at that wall all morning!

completion.speaker: Haskel
completion.text: My spyglass! Not even scratched! Here, the boots are yours, as I promised. A courier left them here and never came back for them.

after.speaker: Haskel
after.text: I can see clear to the barrows now. Thanks again!

journal.text: Recover Haskel's spyglass from the Urchins.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Haskel's spyglass from the Urchins.

variants.specifics: Vesk: Ambrus the Ferryman; the Urchins of the east shore caves stole his spyglass, which he keeps watch on the Weeping Isle with.

offer.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
offer.text: Hail, Wanderer! Want to learn a spell? Then do me a favor. The Urchins in the caves on the east shore stole my spyglass right off my ferry! I can't keep watch on the Weeping Isle without it. Bring it back and I'll teach you a fine spell. Is it a bargain?

refusal.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
refusal.text: No? Then don't come asking me for a ride to the Isle.

reminder.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
reminder.text: Got my spyglass? No? Then what are you standing around for?

completion.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
completion.text: My spyglass! Not a scratch on it! Here, take this book. The spell inside is yours now. Learn it well!

after.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
after.text: You should go see Mayor Ostrin. He's been pacing up and down the big dock all morning.

journal.text: Recover Ambrus' spyglass from the Urchins of the east shore.

journal_done.text: Speak with Mayor Ostrin on the big dock.

variants.specifics: Vorne: Feldrim, who teaches battle magic, had his Force Wand stolen from his desk by Sarvok's Imps; they hide in the old granary.

offer.speaker: Feldrim
offer.text:
Sir! Stop them! Thieves!

...Gone. Blast it all! Sarvok's Imps came in at my window and took my Force Wand right off the desk. I teach battle magic, and I can't teach it with my bare hands. Get it back and I'll teach you a spell for your trouble. Will you do it?

refusal.speaker: Feldrim
refusal.text: Then don't! I'll catch the little devils myself.

reminder.speaker: Feldrim
reminder.text: Still nothing?! Those Imps hide out in the old granary, everybody knows that. Go and look!

completion.speaker: Feldrim
completion.text: My wand! Hah! Now those Imps had better watch out. Take this spell book, stranger, as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Feldrim
after.text: Thanks again, stranger. My class is back in session!

journal.text: Recover Feldrim's Force Wand from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Feldrim's Force Wand from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Fort Kholm: Gorrin, the signal keeper, wants back the spyglass the Urchins of the Snow Caves stole from his tower.

offer.speaker: Gorrin
offer.text:
Bother and blast! Robbed again?! Those nefarious little Urchins crept into the signal tower in the night and pilfered my spyglass! Without it I cannot keep watch on the pass. Ulvana's Undead could march right up to the gate and I would be none the wiser!

The thieves keep a den in the Snow Caves, west of the Ice Bridge. If you could get my spyglass back, the whole fort would sleep easier. Will you go after it?

refusal.speaker: Gorrin
refusal.text: Then I shall keep the watch with these poor old eyes. Hmph.

reminder.speaker: Gorrin
reminder.text: Any sign of my spyglass? I've been squinting at that pass all day!

completion.speaker: Gorrin
completion.text:
My spyglass! Splendid! Now I can resume my vigil.

Here, take this spell book. A traveling Wizard left it with me years ago to pay for his supper. I never could make sense of a word in it.

journal.text: Recover Gorrin's spyglass from the Urchins in the Snow Caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Gorrin's spyglass from the Urchins in the Snow Caves.

variants.specifics: Fornath: Fennick the assayer, a nervous fusspot, lost his Salamander Cloak to the Imps of the Cinder Caves; he pays with the key to the Smiths' Gate and sends the player on to Kasrak.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text: Aiiieee! Get back! Get back, I say! ... Oh. Oh, it's a person. Forgive me, I thought the Imps had come back for the rest of my things. They crept down my chimney and stole my Salamander Cloak! Go to the Cinder Caves south of town and get it back for me.

refusal.speaker: Fennick
refusal.text: Well! Fine. I'll ask somebody with a little more backbone.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: My cloak? Have you got it? Oh.... Oh dear.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text:
My cloak! My Salamander Cloak! Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Here, take this brass key. It opens the Smiths' Gate on the north side of the square. Nobody will bother you on that road.

after.speaker: Fennick
after.text: Master Kasrak was looking for you. He's waiting in the Anvil Hall.

journal.text: Recover Fennick's Salamander Cloak from the Imps.

journal_done.text: Return to Master Kasrak in the Anvil Hall.

variants.specifics: Wendle Cross: Lord Belgrin, an old gentleman, wants back the enchanted Lantern the Imps stole from his house in the night.

offer.speaker: Belgrin
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer. You find me in a most deplorable predicament. In the dead of night a horde of malodorous Imps invaded my house and purloined my enchanted Lantern! Without it I cannot find my own door after sundown. If you could get it back, you would save an old man a great deal of misery. Will you undertake this task?

refusal.speaker: Belgrin
refusal.text: Then I shall bear the darkness alone. Good day to you.

reminder.speaker: Belgrin
reminder.text: Have you no news of my Lantern? Someone saw the Imps flitting about the old lime kiln at dusk. Make haste!

completion.speaker: Belgrin
completion.text: My Lantern! You have recovered it! I am in your debt, kind sir. Here are 100 gold pieces, a modest recompense for your valor.

after.speaker: Belgrin
after.text: My thanks again, Wanderer. My door is always open to you.

journal.text: Recover Lord Belgrin's enchanted Lantern from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Lord Belgrin's enchanted Lantern from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Hestle: Orlo, a stiff and grand old townsman, has had his amulet stolen by the Imps that nest in the ruined windmill.

offer.speaker: Orlo
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer. I find myself besieged by misfortune. Nefarious Imps have absconded with my amulet, and without it I am wholly defenceless against these abominable Ogres. Will you liberate it from those wretched creatures?

refusal.speaker: Orlo
refusal.text: How very disappointing. I had thought better of you.

reminder.speaker: Orlo
reminder.text: The Imps? I am told they nest in the old windmill west of town.

completion.speaker: Orlo
completion.text: My amulet! Splendid! Simply splendid! You have my most profound gratitude, brave Adventurer. Take these boots, with my compliments.

after.speaker: Orlo
after.text: Thanks again! I shall not let it out of my sight again, I assure you.

journal.text: Recover Orlo's amulet from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Orlo's amulet from the Imps.
